text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
My next travel itinerary... Relaxing 
around Lake Akan... Or maybe going 
abroad...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Well, if I get bored I can just take off. 
First Dubai, and then from there, Hong—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
No, if anything, it's not enough. I want 
to go to every single place I possibly 
can.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
This life is so completely free— it'd be a 
waste not to enjoy every bit of it!
